methodology.offNightDefinition: A date with 8 or fewer NHL games
methodology.pairingDefinition: For one active slot, usable dates are the union of both team schedules; conflicts are shared dates.
methodology.playerScoringReference: Cracked Ice default; editorial reference only. On-site tools use each user's saved league settings.
methodology.availabilityRule: No player is described as available without league-specific provenance.
